tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the top-level documentation and workspace manifests to understand the product scope and the split between the backend and frontend applications.

tour.title: Backend Host and Composition
tour.description: These files show how the ASP.NET host starts, loads configuration, and wires the core and WMS projects together.

tour.title: Shared Backend Core
tour.description: The shared backend core contains reusable web infrastructure, middleware, authentication, and database primitives used across the solution.

tour.title: Warehouse Domain Services
tour.description: Inspect a controller, service, and entity from the WMS project to see how warehouse-specific behavior is implemented on top of the shared core.

tour.title: Frontend Bootstrap
tour.description: Follow the Vue application bootstrapping path through the main entry, root app, router, store, and UI plugin setup.

tour.title: Frontend Business Flows
tour.description: These representative API, view, and component files show how the frontend translates warehouse workflows into screens and reusable UI building blocks.

tour.title: Local Setup and Deployment
tour.description: Use the deployment and helper files to understand local setup, container packaging, and developer automation.
